name: Algebraic Compatibility Summation
description: Replaces the structural definition of a triangle (three mutually connected vertices or mutual members of a prohibition set) with an algebraic condition on a pairwise compatibility function. By defining C(u,v)=0 for prohibited pairs and C(u,v)=1 otherwise, the condition that three materials are mutually prohibited is transformed into the equation C(a,b) + C(b,c) + C(a,c) = 0. This forces the model to deduce that the sum of non-negative integers equals zero if and only if all terms are zero, breaking surface-level graph pattern matching.
